hints.title: Partition Letters and Digits
hints.text: Separate characters of s into two lists: letters and digits.

hints.title: Length Difference Constraint
hints.text: If abs(len(letters) - len(digits)) > 1, it is impossible to reformat with alternating types, so return empty string.

hints.title: Interleave Characters
hints.text: Start with whichever list has greater length, then alternate between the two lists until both are empty.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Permuting characters and validating alternation takes factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Separating into two arrays takes linear time and memory for interleaving.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks length difference <= 1 and interleaves starting with longer bucket.
complexity.notes: No two adjacent characters can be of the same type.
